title: Vercel Pro to self-hosted Coolify
summary: Coolify gives you a Vercel-shaped deploy experience on your own VPS. The seat price is only half the story — Vercel's usage billing is the other half.

you_lose: Vercel's edge network — this is the big one, and it is not something a single VPS replicates
Instant global cache invalidation and automatic image optimisation
Zero-config Next.js features that only exist because Vercel builds both sides
Preview deployments that scale to zero for free
you_gain: A fixed monthly bill instead of a usage bill that can spike without warning
Free seats, and no per-seat charge for a viewer who just wants to see logs
Any runtime you like, not only the ones the platform supports

caveats: If your traffic is global and latency-sensitive, one VPS is a genuine downgrade and no amount of savings fixes that. Put Cloudflare in front of it or stay on Vercel.
The $20/seat Vercel figure excludes usage overages. If your bandwidth bill is the reason you are reading this, your real Vercel cost is higher and Coolify wins sooner.
Coolify itself needs headroom on top of the applications you deploy. The 4 GB here is for Coolify plus a couple of small apps, not a full production estate.
